subject.title: fix(ci): enforce plugin SDK API baseline

question: Should CI owners preserve historical-target validation by compatibility-gating this new shard while also treating the generated Plugin SDK baseline as a validation-bearing file rather than docs-only content?
rationale: The required behavior spans CI compatibility policy and changed-file routing; the mechanical fixes are clear, but the repository owner must confirm the supported historical-target contract and the intended PR-cost tradeoff.

options.title: Preserve both CI contracts
options.body: Add the established historical-target guard and route baseline-only changes through the API check so generated contract updates cannot bypass validation.

options.title: Narrow historical support
options.body: Intentionally make the new API check mandatory for historical targets too, but document that this changes the supported validation contract.

recommendation.title: Preserve both CI contracts
recommendation.body: Add the established historical-target guard and route baseline-only changes through the API check so generated contract updates cannot bypass validation.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied history connects this contributor to the recent SDK declaration and baseline changes that the CI policy is intended to protect.
